name: counters-spec-lint
description: Pinned Spectral toolchain for the openapi-validate CI job. The lockfile freezes the whole dependency tree so a bad upstream release of a transitive dependency cannot break the spec-lint gate. The @asyncapi/specs override skips 6.11.2, a broken publish that crashes on import (`module is not defined in ES module scope`); Spectral pulls that package transitively for AsyncAPI support the OpenAPI lint never uses. Regenerate with `npm install` here and commit the lockfile.
